# Doctor Dave

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P0](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P49](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0049)</sub>
- **Role:** Doctor  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P49](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0049), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P54](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0054), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P1](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P12](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0012)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Doctor Dave is a big, jolly old fellow. He is characterized by his white whiskers.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P0](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0000)_

## Personality

Doctor Dave is a gruff individual who lacks tact, frequently bringing up insensitive topics in conversation. He is also rather prejudiced against modern surgical procedures, which he dismisses as new-fangled practices.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P49](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0049), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P54](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0054), [v4 CHAPTER 29 GILBERT AND ANNE DISAGREE P20](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0020)_

## History

Doctor Dave maintained a forty-year feud with the over-harbor people and advised [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) twelve years prior that nothing could be done for [Dick](../character/dick.md). He and his wife joined Captain Jim to welcome [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) to their new home in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) over supper, where the company discussed their neighbors around the harbor.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P0](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P8](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P16](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P34](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0034), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037), [v4 CHAPTER 29 GILBERT AND ANNE DISAGREE P18](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0018)_
